art_direction: 珊瑚红马尾女性跃起发排球，一手上挥、双腿前后错开，青绿天空与橙红球场充满动势。
composition_variation: One exceptionally attractive original adult woman aged 25 performing a volleyball jump serve on an empty outdoor court. Coral-red ponytail, golden hair highlights, vivid turquoise eyes, sharply drawn adult features and a bright competitive smile. Opaque turquoise short-sleeved performance shirt, loose navy mid-thigh sports shorts, white knee pads and white-coral volleyball shoes. Capture her clearly airborne with feet separated front-to-back and knees naturally flexed. Her striking arm extends upward and slightly forward with an open palm approaching the ball, while the non-striking arm lowers diagonally for balance. The ball is one white-coral-teal sphere above and just in front of the striking hand, never obscuring her face. Head tilts slightly upward to follow it. Keep the entire hand-ball relationship beneath the clean top 20 percent of sky. A small three-quarter side angle allows the raised arm, torso and two legs to remain readable in a narrow full-body composition. Saturated turquoise sky, blazing coral court, cobalt shadows and a low golden fence. Two restrained curved orange paint trails behind her emphasize upward momentum. Strong beautiful face detail and wind-swept hair, believable shoulder rotation, no duplicate ball or extra arms, energetic nonsexual athletic illustration.
